tweets.text:
The VCL is almost over. My team qualified for the Masters Cup where we will have a final 5v5 to crown a champion. Our regular season run has been insane, winning 11 out of 12 weeks and tying one. 
I was the 3rd best player of the tour, just behind my fellow teammate Samu. 

Thank you for the opportunity @SuperNovaVGC Lets bring it home next week 😤

Facto del día, Si Folagor hubiese jugado el torneo del Pro Locke hubiese quedado top4 con bastante seguridad.

Al no ser Ramdon se le hubiese facilitado el Team Building 

además de que su experiencia en VGC le iba a dar estamina y adaptabilidad al mejor de tres
